Claim 7 (Currently Amended): A method for preventing or treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered in a manner that provides a measurable reduction in intraocular pressure.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered in a manner that provides a measurable reduction in intraocular pressure.
